findings.event: Peer-reviewed publication: choline-tryptophan ionic liquid (CHAT) excipient enables >200 mg/mL antibody formulations, viscosity <20 cP, improved SC bioavailability vs saline in mice
findings.source_name: Advanced Healthcare Materials (Wiley) / Harvard -- via search-engine snippets only, direct fetch EGRESS_BLOCKED
findings.summary: BACKFILL: a second, distinct peer-reviewed paper from the Harvard/Mitragotri group, published in Advanced Healthcare Materials, extending the already-tracked ionic-liquid (CHAT) excipient work to a new study on antibody bioavailability. Date unconfirmed against any primary source this run (all 8 hosts tried were EGRESS_BLOCKED); flagged pending confirmation.
findings.summary_ko: 백필: 하버드/Mitragotri 그룹의 두 번째 동료심사 논문으로, Advanced Healthcare Materials에 게재되었으며 이미 추적 중인 이온성 액체(CHAT) 부형제 연구를 항체 생체이용률에 관한 새로운 연구로 확장한다. 이번 실행에서는 어떤 1차 출처로도 날짜를 확인하지 못했으며(시도한 8개 호스트 모두 EGRESS_BLOCKED), 검토 필요로 표시한다.

run_notes.tier5_earning_its_cost: Tier 5 surfaced two items a name-search alone would likely have missed or mis-dated: (1) the CHMP pembrolizumab 'SC administration' headline, which cross-referencing the businesswire source's embedded URL date (20250918) revealed to be a September 2025 opinion resurfacing in a 2026 search, not a new event -- caught by 1.5.1 date verification, preventing a false-fresh log; (2) confirmation that the CHMP Ocrevus pediatric extension applies to the IV formulation only, which required reading past the ocrelizumab-brand headline match to the formulation-specific detail before rejecting it on Gate A. Both were direct regulator/press lookups, not name-search hits on 'subcutaneous' keywords -- consistent with why Tier 5 exists.
